steps.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ and sign in with username admin and password admin (if a 'change password' prompt appears, skip it). Then navigate to the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' and report the titles of all its panels exactly as displayed on the dashboard.

recorded.panel_titles: Request rate, Error count, Latency by endpoint

steps.instruction: In Grafana, create a NEW dashboard (New -> Dashboard). Add a visualization panel: choose the 'TestData' data source ( TestData DB / grafana-testdata-datasource) as its query source, change the panel type from the default Time series to 'Stat', and set the panel title to exactly '{{runid}} Availability'. Apply the panel edit. Then save the dashboard with the title exactly '{{runid}} {{01-open.dashboard_folder}} Dashboard' (leave folder as General unless prompted otherwise). After saving, report the dashboard's URL as shown in the browser address bar and its UID, and confirm the Stat panel titled '{{runid}} Availability' is visible on the dashboard.

recorded.panel_visible_on_final_dashboard: not re-confirmed after save (browser left on Settings tab)

steps.instruction: On the Grafana dashboard '{{runid}} {{01-open.dashboard_folder}} Dashboard' (UID {{02-create.url.p1}}), leave the Settings tab and go back to the dashboard view. Add a NEW Text panel: click Add -> Visualization, change the panel type from Time series to 'Text', set the panel title to exactly '{{runid}} Notes', and put text content that includes the string '{{runid}}' (e.g. '{{01-open.dashboard_folder}} run {{runid}} notes'). Apply the edit. Then SAVE the dashboard (accepting/keeping the existing title '{{runid}} {{01-open.dashboard_folder}} Dashboard'). After saving, report whether the Text panel titled '{{runid}} Notes' is visible on the dashboard and what text it displays, and confirm the Stat panel '{{runid}} Availability' is also still present.

On the Grafana dashboard '{{runid}} {{01-open.dashboard_folder}} Dashboard' (UID {{02-create.url.p1}}), do two things and persist them: (1) Add the tag 'bench' to the dashboard via Dashboard settings -> General -> Tags (type 'bench' and press Enter to add it as a tag chip). (2) Set the dashboard's time range to 'Last 6 hours' using the time picker in the top bar. Then SAVE the dashboard, and in the save dialog make sure the checkbox 'Update default time range' IS TICKED/checked before confirming the save (this is required so the 6-hour range is persisted into the saved dashboard). After saving, report: the tags shown in dashboard settings, the time range shown in the top-bar time picker, and whether the 'Update default time range' checkbox was ticked at save time.

recorded.panels_visible: fwgr43-n1 Notes (text: Bench run fwgr43-n1 notes), fwgr43-n1 Availability (stat: 87.8)

steps.instruction: On the Grafana dashboard '{{runid}} {{01-open.dashboard_folder}} Dashboard' (UID {{02-create.url.p1}}), set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to '1m' (one minute): open the refresh picker in the top bar (the dropdown next to the refresh/reload icon) and select the interval '1m' so auto-refresh is enabled at 1 minute. Then SAVE the dashboard (keep the existing title '{{runid}} {{01-open.dashboard_folder}} Dashboard'; do NOT change the time range). After saving, verify persistence by opening Dashboard settings -> JSON Model and report the value of the 'refresh' field in the saved JSON, plus the dashboard 'version' number. Also report what the top-bar refresh picker currently shows.

recorded.topbar_refresh_picker_aria: Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected

steps.instruction: Final verification of the Grafana dashboard '{{runid}} {{01-open.dashboard_folder}} Dashboard' (UID {{02-create.url.p1}}): reload the dashboard page fresh (navigate to it directly, e.g. via search, so nothing is cached in edit state) and report: (1) the exact URL in the browser address bar; (2) the titles of all panels visible on the dashboard; (3) the text content of the Text panel; (4) the top-bar time range; (5) the top-bar auto-refresh interval; (6) the dashboard's tags as shown in Dashboard settings -> General (or JSON Model). Do not change anything — this is read-only verification.
